newsitem.title: USA: Midland Cogeneration Q4 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Midland Cogeneration Q4 net rises.

text.p: Midland Cogeneration Venture (MCV) said Monday it had fourth quarter earnings of $14.9 million, up from $11.6 million in the year-ago quarter.

Earnings for all of 1996 were $65.5 million, an increase over $60.9 million for the 1995 full year. The rise was largely attributable to the receipt of about $19 million in refunds and interest from Great Lakes Pipeline, MCV said.
MCV said it met the required qualifying facility standards in 1996, achieving an operating ratio of 15 percent and an efficiency ratio of 45.5 percent.

MCV also said it will spend about $5.9 million to install a small steam turbine purchased from ABB Group. The turbine, expected to be operational this summer, will allow MCV to generate up to 42 megawatts of additional electricity under certain conditions.

MCV partners include CMS Midland Inc, a unit of CMS Energy Corp; Dow Chemical Co; Source Midland LP, an affiliate of PanEnergy Corp; Coastal Midland Inc, a unit of Coastal Corp; MEI LP, a unit of ABB; Micogen LP, a unit of Fluor Corp; and C-E Midland Inc, another unit of ABB.
